public_commitment: Publicly committed to disclosing the climate risk in its lending book.
Publicly committed to clear country-of-origin labeling on everything it sells.
Publicly committed to holding capital well above the regulatory minimum.
Publicly committed to removing every level crossing on its network.
Publicly committed to farming without synthetic pesticides.
Publicly committed to hardening its lines against wildfire.
Publicly committed to removing single-use plastic from all its packaging by 2030.
Publicly committed to compensating passengers for every delay it causes.
Publicly committed to supporting a national clean electricity standard and retiring its coal plants by 2035.
Publicly committed to training 500 new shipyard apprentices a year.
Publicly committed to giving every user one-click deletion of their data.
Publicly committed to capping out-of-pocket insulin at $35 a month.
Publicly committed to cutting prior authorization delays for patients.
Publicly committed to paying its full statutory tax rate in every country it operates in.
Publicly committed to building out offshore wind capacity.
